{{# Calculated-field flag — `calculation_query: true` in the blueprint opts the field into the public-form calculation engine at `resources/js/calculation-engine.js`. When on, we surface the formula / type / decimals as `data-calculation-*` attributes the engine picks up, and render the input read-only so users can see the computed value without fighting Alpine for control of it. #}} {{# Surface unmapped fieldtype renders. A fieldtype hitting default.antlers.html either (a) intentionally delegates here via {{ partial:vendor/statamic/forms/fields/default }} (documented at the call site), or (b) has no per-fieldtype template — a gap to fill at resources/views/vendor/statamic/forms/fields/.antlers.html. The HTML comment is visible in page source for devs and invisible to users. #}}
